title: The Bus to the Park
text:
Anna is new in town. She has a map of the city. The bus stop is near her house. The bus goes to the park every twenty minutes.

The first bus leaves at 8 o'clock. The last bus leaves at 6 o'clock in the evening. The timetable is on the wall at the bus stop. Anna checks it every morning.

questions.text: How often does the bus go to the park?
Why does Anna check the timetable every morning?
options: She wants to know when the bus leaves
She wants to buy a new map
She is waiting for a friend

questions.text: What can you say about Anna?
options: She uses buses to get around
She works at the bus stop

vocabulary.definition: a list showing the times when buses or trains leave and arrive
a drawing that shows the streets and places in an area
a large vehicle that carries many passengers along a road
goes away from a place at a set time

paragraph_translations: Анна нова в місті. У неї є карта міста. Автобусна зупинка знаходиться біля її будинку. Автобус їздить до парку кожні двадцять хвилин.
Перший автобус відправляється о восьмій годині. Останній автобус відправляється о шостій годині вечора. Розклад висить на стіні на автобусній зупинці. Анна перевіряє його кожного ранку.
